narrative.overview:
The badminton court is the page. White lines on sky-blue vinyl are the ground, and everything is drawn the way a court is marked: the active thing is solid, the inactive thing is dashed, and exactly one colour, cork yellow, says "do this". The palette is sampled from the club's own logo.

The marketing site speaks loudly with italic condensed jersey type, a tilted sticker logo and perforated session tickets. The signed-in console keeps the same world but works quietly: the court shows up as state, and the hosts' numbers read like a scoreboard. Light only, because it is used outdoors in daylight.
keyCharacteristics: Chunky and confident: large rounded surfaces, 2px borders, one obvious primary action per view.
Solid means active, dashed means inactive or closed.
Cork yellow is the only action colour and always carries navy text.
Numerals are display type, tabular, and read like a scoreboard.
Text on sky is white; it is never grey.

rules.name: The One Action Rule
rules.body: Cork yellow means the next action. If two things on a screen are cork, one of them is wrong.

rules.name: The Solid-Dashed Rule
rules.body: Active, open and in use are solid. Closed, idle-but-unavailable and inactive are dashed or muted. Never use colour alone to say it.

rules.name: The Scoreboard Numeral Rule
rules.body: Any number read at a glance is display type with tabular figures, never body text.

rules.name: The Navy Shadow Rule
rules.body: Shadows are always tinted navy and defined once as theme tokens. Do not write shadow values inline.

dos: Do use cork yellow once per view, for the next action, with navy text.
Do keep every touch target at least 44px on phones and keep focus rings visible.
Do draw state with fill, border style and text together: solid for active, dashed for inactive.
Do use the shadow tokens and OKLCH colour tokens; add a token before writing a one-off value.
Do keep motion to one authored moment (the shuttlecock drift) plus small hover lifts, and remove them under prefers-reduced-motion. Fades may stay.
Do make Bahasa Indonesia and English layouts survive the longer string.
donts: Don't add a dark theme or dark: classes: the product is used in daylight and ships light only.
Don't use grey text on sky or navy fields; use white or a tint of the field.
Don't invent testimonials, member counts or photos. Show real data or nothing.
Don't put an eyebrow label above a heading or use gradient text.
Don't fire a destructive action on one tap, or place it in the same row as the primary action without a confirm.
Don't use hard offset shadows or black shadows.
